definitions.explanation: The act of applying color to something, or the colors and color scheme of a finished work. Used for art, crafts, photography, and decorative work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仏像|ぶつぞう}→仏像：09638_butsuzou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{彩色|さいしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}す→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧。
examples.english: To apply coloring to a Buddhist statue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧な{彩色|さいしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目|め}を{引|ひ}く→目を引く：30622_mewohiku⟧。
examples.english: The vivid coloring catches the eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天井|てんじょう}→天井：05008_tenjou⟧{画|が}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何百年|なんびゃくねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{彩色|さいしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: The coloring of this temple's ceiling paintings still remains from hundreds of years ago.

notes:
A compound of {彩|さい} (color, coloring) and {色|しょく} (color). Often used in contexts involving traditional arts, crafts, architecture, and restoration. The word carries a more refined, artistic nuance than simply ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧ (to paint a color).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {彩色|さいしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}す→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧: to apply coloring
- {彩色|さいしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to color, to paint
- ⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧な{彩色|さいしょく}: vivid coloring
- {彩色|さいしょく}⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: hand-colored photograph
- {彩色|さいしょく}⟦{木彫|もくちょう}→木彫：24080_mokuchou⟧: painted wood carving

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{着色|ちゃくしょく}→着色：13708_chakushoku⟧: coloring, dyeing — more technical, used for food coloring or industrial processes
- ⟦{配色|はいしょく}→配色：15886_haishoku⟧: color arrangement, color scheme — focuses on the combination and placement of colors
- ⟦{塗装|とそう}→塗装：06582_tosou⟧: painting, coating — applying paint as a protective or decorative layer, often for buildings or vehicles

USAGE:
The alternate reading {彩色|さいしき} also exists and appears in some older or literary texts. In modern standard usage, さいしょく is more common.
